mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% consistently compresses discount rates and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and equity valuation compression.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in payrolls (UNRATE > 3.8 and PAYEMS < 149500) signal labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 3.8 and PAYEMS < 149500.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions (GDP growth > 2.5% and industrial production > 105), a rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) triggers equity market sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% and INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1.2 million units per month indicate robust consumer demand and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index) indicates a contraction in manufacturing, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 500000) combined with robust labor market conditions (PAYEMS > 149000) signals sustained economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 500000 and PAYEMS > 149000.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% during monetary tightening cycles leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to prolonged liquidity constraints and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.
